revisions.description: Makes one HTTP request and returns the status code and the response. Any 2xx succeeds; another status fails the task, with the status and response still set as results.

changelog.reason: The http command runs again (it was disabled, so the task did nothing and reported success); helper text describes how codes, bodies and redirects behave

params.label: URL
params.helpertext: The request URL, http or https. Credentials or a query string in it are left out of the log
params.name: url

params.description: Start a new line for each header
params.label: Headers
params.helpertext: One header per line, as Name: value; quotes around a name or value are dropped. Values are never logged
params.name: header

params.label: Content Type
params.helpertext: Sets the Content-Type header. For a JSON type (application/json or +json) the body must be valid JSON
params.name: contentType

params.label: Body
params.helpertext: Sent exactly as written; a JSON body is checked, not reformatted
params.name: body

params.label: Allow Untrusted SSL Certs
params.helpertext: Skip verifying the server's TLS certificate, e.g. a self-signed one
params.name: allowUntrustedCerts

params.description: If provided, the result parameter is not filled
params.label: Response File Path
params.helpertext: A workspace file, absolute or relative to /workspace, to write the response to as received; the Response result is then empty. Needed for a response over 3000 bytes
params.name: outputFilePath

results.description: The response body, when it fits in a result (3000 bytes) and Response File Path is blank; also set on a failed call when it fits
results.name: response

results.description: The HTTP status code received, also set on a failed call
results.name: statusCode
